title: Remote Content Writer
description:
About the Role:

We’re looking for a Content Writer to craft high-quality business and strategy questions, case studies, and structured content across diverse management domains with No prior AI experience required . This role is ideal for someone with strong analytical skills, excellent written English, and an MBA/business background who enjoys turning complex ideas into clear, engaging content


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop business/strategy questions in finance, public policy, e-commerce, sports analytics, etc.
  • Create case studies and real-world scenarios for MBA-level learners.
  • Organize content using structured formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • Ensure clarity, accuracy, and professionalism in all outputs.
  • Collaborate with experts to align content with real-world applications.


What We’re Looking For:

  • MBA or bachelor’s from a Tier-1/2 institute in business, economics, commerce, or management.
  • 1–5 years’ experience in content, consulting, research, or analysis.
  • Strong logical/analytical thinking and excellent written English.
  • Familiarity with structured file formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • No prior AI experience is required
  • Bonus: prior experience in case study writing or academic/business content.


Why Join Us:

  • Work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Flexible, remote-first environment.
  • Competitive pay with potential contract extensions.
  • Freelance perks: exposure to advanced AI, flexible hours, global collaboration.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated challenge (60 mins).
  • Once you clear the challenge, we will reach out to you for an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


About Turing:

Turing, based in San Francisco, is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises. We advance cutting-edge research with high-quality data, training pipelines, and top AI talent across coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents. We also help enterprises turn AI from proof-of-concept into proprietary systems that deliver reliable performance, measurable impact, and real results on the P&L.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Supervisor(a) de Projetos Digitais
description:
Sobre a Idiomus


Com mais de 100.000 alunos ao redor do mundo, a Idiomus é uma das edtechs que mais crescem. Há mais de 7 anos no mercado, presente em mais de 98 países , o Grupo Idiomus ajuda milhares de pessoas a se tornarem sua melhor versão.


Aqui, bons projetos não ficam só no papel . Eles precisam sair do planejamento e virar execução consistente.


E para isso, buscamos um(a) Supervisor(a) de Projetos Digitais com olhar atento, mente analítica e habilidade para garantir que nada trave o que precisa acontecer .


Essa é uma posição ideal para profissionais que amam organização, têm forte senso de responsabilidade, sabem cuidar da execução e manter todos na mesma página .


O que oferecemos


  • Trabalho 100% remoto
  • Remuneração: R$5.000,00/mês
  • Horário flexível
  • Acesso a cursos e treinamentos avançados
  • Contato direto com times de Growth, Tráfego, Conteúdo, Produto e Mídia
  • Ambiente de alta performance , com entregas semanais e foco total em resultado
  • Oportunidade de crescimento dentro da estrutura de gestão de projetos da Idiomus


O que você vai fazer por aqui


  • Supervisionar o andamento de projetos de marketing digital , especialmente em frentes de growth
  • Acompanhar cronogramas, sprints e entregas definidas pelo gerente de projetos ou líderes de área
  • Organizar tarefas, checklists e responsáveis , garantindo que nada fique parado ou fora de rota
  • Fazer follow-ups estratégicos com os envolvidos, mantendo cadência e clareza no fluxo
  • Garantir que as demandas certas sejam executadas pelas pessoas certas, no tempo certo
  • Identificar travas ou gargalos operacionais e escalar com rapidez aos líderes do time
  • Apoiar a organização de materiais, documentações, prazos e atualizações de status para o time de growth e performance


Quem estamos buscando


  • Alguém com perfil extremamente organizado e orientado a entregas
  • Que goste de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, com projetos simultâneos e ritmo acelerado
  • Que tenha experiência real com marketing digital, especialmente performance e growth
  • Que goste de fazer acontecer nos bastidores , garantindo que tudo flua conforme o plano
  • Que tenha boa capacidade de análise, iniciativa e senso de urgência sem perder o cuidado com os detalhes


Requisitos


  • Experiência comprovada em gestão ou supervisão de projetos de marketing digital , com entregas frequentes em ambientes de performance e growth
  • Vivência prática em operações de tráfego, conteúdo, criativos, funis ou lançamentos digitais
  • Ter atuado em agências, startups, infoprodutores ou times de marketing com múltiplas squads
  • Conhecimento prático em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Sprints)
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Notion ou similares
  • Capacidade de lidar com deadlines, múltiplos stakeholders e entregas em paralelo


Diferenciais valorizados


  • Familiaridade com projetos que envolvam campanhas de mídia paga, criativos, testes A/B e funis
  • Certificação Scrum Master ou experiência prática com facilitação de squads
  • Experiência com automação de tarefas ou construção de processos operacionais
  • Noções de funil de marketing
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas como Meta Ads, Google Ads, Sheets e Looker Studio


Por que essa vaga importa


Você será responsável por garantir que os projetos que escalam a empresa saiam do papel e sigam em execução contínua.


O gestor traça o plano e você garante que ele aconteça. E, nesse nível de crescimento, isso é absolutamente estratégico.


Processo Seletivo


O processo inclui teste prático obrigatório , com foco em priorização, clareza de execução e organização de demandas.


Como se candidatar


  • Aperte no botão \"Candidatar-se\"
  • Preencha o formulário com suas informações.
  • Ficar atento ao se e-mail. Os candidatos selecionados na primeira etapa receberão o convite para o teste prático , que deverá ser realizado e enviado dentro do prazo estipulado para avançar no processo.


Vamos lá?

title: Business Analyst & Scrum Master(Supply chain)
description:
Remote Role Business Analyst & Scrum Master

Assignment length 1 year

Max Bill Rate: Will depend on years of experience (5–8+ years in analytics/BA roles; 3–5+ years Scrum Master experience.

Worker MUST be based in São Paulo, Brazil


We are hiring for our USA Client; payment is USD; Monthly Pay, No Benefits

Candidate need to have a short notice period

Candidate need to use their personal computer for work

Candidate need to have an excellent English communication skills


About the Role

We’re seeking a Business Analyst & Scrum Master to help drive the delivery of our Supply Chain Analytics product teams. You’ll partner with planning, logistics, and manufacturing domain leaders to translate business needs into actionable insights, while facilitating agile delivery for a set of cross-functional teams.


Key Responsibilities:

Product & Business Analysis (80%)

• Partner with Supply Chain stakeholders (Demand Planning, S&OP, Logistics, Procurement, Manufacturing, Customer Service) to elicit requirements, define user stories, and map processes.

• Translate business problems into analytics solutions (dashboards, KPIs, data marts, alerts) aligned to product vision and roadmap.

• Create and maintain artifacts: user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps (BPMN), data dictionaries, and data lineage.

• Perform data discovery and profiling in Snowflake, write performant SQL (CTEs, window functions), validate data quality, and reconcile with source systems.

• Review Power BI reports and semantic models; review row-level security (RLS), calculation groups, and DAX measures.

• Define and monitor KPIs (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory turns, case fill rate, OTIF, production adherence, DC throughput, transportation cost per case).

• Support data governance (metadata, access controls, quality rules) and contribute to analytics best practices.


Scrum Master & Delivery (20%)

• Serve as Scrum Master for the product team: facilitate daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

• Coach the team in agile principles (empiricism, transparency, iterative delivery) and help remove impediments.

• Maintain a healthy backlog and sprint cadence; utilize velocity and cycle time to forecast delivery.

• Foster collaboration across business, data engineering, analytics, and platform teams (Snowflake, CI/CD, security).

• Promote definition of ready/done, test automation where applicable, and measurable outcomes per sprint/release.

• Track and communicate progress via roadmaps, burnup/burndown, and stakeholder updates.


Qualifications

• 5–8+ years in analytics/BA roles; 3–5+ years Scrum Master experience.

• Proficiency in Snowflake, SQL, and Power BI (DAX, RLS, modeling).

• Strong grounding in data modeling, ETL/ELT, and data quality.

• CPG supply chain experience (demand, inventory, production, logistics).

• Excellent facilitation and communication skills.


Preferred

• CSM/PSM, PL-300, SnowPro Core

• SAP/Blue Yonder/Kinaxis exposure

• Familiarity with S&OP, APS, ERP (SAP/ECC/S4), TMS/WMS data structures and integration patterns.

• Knowledge of data governance frameworks (e.g., data quality rules, stewardship, cataloging)


Tools & Environment

• Snowflake, SQL

• Power BI (Desktop & Service)

• Azure DevOps (work management)

• Data Catalog/Governance (e.g., Collibra or internal)

• ERP/APS/TMS/WMS integrations (SAP, Blue Yonder, etc.)


What You’ll Impact

• Service levels (case fill, OTIF), inventory turns, forecast accuracy, and cost-to-serve.

• Data product reliability, scalability, and stakeholder adoption.

title: Operations Director
description:
About the Company

Our client is a well-established Hong Kong-based multinational trading group with expanding operations across South America. They are seeking a seasoned Trading Director to lead their mining and/or food commodities trading business in the region.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead business development and market expansion across South America (primarily Brazil, Argentina, and surrounding countries)
  • Build and maintain long-term strategic relationships with key customers, suppliers, and partners
  • Oversee all daily trading operations including sourcing, sales, logistics, pricing, and risk management
  • Develop and execute regional profit strategies to drive sustainable growth and strong financial performance
  • Act as the company’s senior representative in South America, ensuring alignment between local operations and global headquarters
  • Collaborate closely with the Hong Kong/China headquarters and provide regular performance updates to senior management


Requirements

  • Minimum 8 years of proven trading experience, with a strong track record in mining (metals, minerals) and/or food commodities (grains, oilseeds, sugar, etc.)
  • Extensive business development and deal-execution experience in South America
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (both written and spoken) is mandatory
  • Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese will be a significant advantage
  • Strong cross-cultural communication and leadership skills; comfortable operating in diverse international environments
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and deep understanding of cross-border trade regulations, logistics, and financing
  • Willingness to relocate long-term to Brazil or Argentina


What We Offer

  • Highly competitive consultancy package
  • Attractive performance-based bonuses tied to P&L results
  • Opportunity to play a pivotal leadership role in a fast-growing international trading house
  • Direct exposure to global markets and senior management in Asia
  • Dynamic, entrepreneurial environment with significant autonomy




We offer an exciting career opportunity to the successful candidate. Interested candidates should submit their detailed CV in English, including current and expected remuneration and availability. Please email to

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Consultor SAP Basis


Buscamos um Consultor SAP Basis qualificado e proativo para gerenciar, manter e otimizar sistemas SAP em um cenário RISE com SAP. Esta função exige experiência prática com ambientes SAP hospedados em nuvem, especialmente em plataformas como SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Analytics Cloud e integração com hiperescaladores (AWS, Azure, GCP). O candidato ideal garantirá alta disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança dos aplicativos SAP e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com provedores SAP e de nuvem.


Responsabilidades:


  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a Equipe de Especialistas do Cliente no escritório do cliente.
  • Experiência com HANA (obrigatório)
  • Gerenciar operações técnicas para SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP BW/4HANA.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Operações de Nuvem SAP, provedores de nuvem e equipes de TI do cliente.
  • Apoiar projetos de migração para o RISE com SAP (integração, conversão de sistemas, atividades de migração para a nuvem).
  • Gerencie a administração de usuários, o gerenciamento de transporte, cópias do sistema, backups, restaurações, aplicação de patches e atualizações.
  • Configure e monitore o SAP Cloud ALM, o Solution Manager ou o Focused Run, conforme apropriado para monitoramento centrado na nuvem.
  • Implemente as melhores práticas de segurança SAP, incluindo o fortalecimento do sistema e as autorizações de usuários.
  • Analise o desempenho do sistema e proponha otimizações.
  • Participe do gerenciamento de incidentes e problemas, análise de causa raiz e monitoramento proativo.
  • Gerencie cortes técnicos para implementações ou atualizações do SAP no ambiente RISE.
  • Crie e mantenha documentação técnica, incluindo runbooks operacionais.
  • Mantenha-se atualizado com as inovações SAP (roadmap RISE, serviços SAP BTP, ofertas de hiperescala).


Requisitos:


  • Experiência como Consultor SAP Basis.
  • Experiência com HANA db. (obrigatório)
  • Inglês avançado

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Talent Specialist
description:
Local: São Paulo, Brasil


Sobre a Posição (About the Role)

Como Especialista de Aquisição de Talentos , você será o ponto focal exclusivo para o recrutamento de ciclo completo no Brasil, atuando em um modelo estratégico de RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing) . Você fará parceria com gerentes contratantes (Hiring Managers) de uma grande empresa farmacêutica para recrutar talentos cruciais, abrangendo desde o nível júnior até o de diretoria. Esta função é uma ponte vital entre coordenadores de contratação e recrutadores sêniores, garantindo a excelência do candidato e um impacto significativo no recrutamento.


Principais Responsabilidades (Key Responsibilities)


  • Recrutamento de ciclo completo para posições altamente especializadas e complexas no setor farmacêutico.
  • Propriedade e execução da contratação para funções de nicho, incluindo Clinical Research Associates (CRAs), Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs) e posições de liderança especializada.
  • Colaboração proativa com gerentes globais para posições com reporte internacional, exigindo forte comunicação para reuniões de alinhamento e intake meetings.
  • Melhorar a experiência do candidato , gerenciando todos os aspectos do engajamento, da logística à comunicação proativa.
  • Servir como o principal recrutador no Brasil, garantindo que as estratégias de sourcing e contratação sejam cultural e comercialmente relevantes.
  • Atuar como um parceiro consultivo para o cliente, oferecendo uma experiência de recrutamento profissional e de alto impacto.


Qualificações Obrigatórias (Required Qualifications)


  • 5+ anos de experiência em recrutamento de ciclo completo (full-cycle recruitment).
  • Capacidade comprovada de recrutar em uma ampla faixa de senioridade, do nível júnior ao de diretoria.
  • Fluência em Português e Inglês é mandatória.

description:
UX/ UI Designer – Swissker

Salary: USD $2,500 – $3,500/month

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time


About Swissker

Swissker is a US-based DTC e-commerce brand specializing in healthcare products that improve everyday wellbeing. We are a fast-growing company powered by data-driven decision-making, ongoing optimization, and a culture of experimentation.

Our focus is on creating high-performance funnels and product experiences that scale across multiple traffic sources and international markets.


Role Overview

We are looking for a UX Designer with strong experience in crafting high-converting user experiences for e-commerce. You will be responsible for designing funnels, advertorials, landing pages, PDPs, checkout flows, and other conversion-focused experiences used in A/B testing and continuous optimization.

You’ll collaborate with CRO, Marketing, Design, and Development teams to deliver clean, modern, and scalable Figma designs that directly impact revenue and KPIs.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design conversion-focused product pages, landing pages, funnels, advertorials, and checkout experiences in Figma.
  • Design versatile graphic assets for use across web pages, advertising creatives, and marketing campaigns, ensuring brand consistency and high visual impact.
  • Work closely with CRO Manager to turn hypotheses into testable UX/UI variations.
  • Create wireframes, high-fidelity layouts, UI components, and design documentation.
  • Collaborate with Developers to ensure accurate, high-quality implementation of designs.
  • Participate in experiment planning, UX reviews, and data-driven improvement discussions.
  • Analyze insights from A/B tests (preferable) and iterate on winning concepts.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a UX/UI Designer in web or e-commerce environments.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma, including components, auto-layout, variants, and prototyping.
  • Proven experience designing web pages, especially e-commerce or funnels.
  • Portfolio is mandatory (web projects, landing pages, funnels, product pages, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and UI/UX best practices.
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, highly structured environment.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to follow processes and documentation standards.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in CRO, A/B testing, or experimentation-driven teams.
  • Experience creating graphic design assets for web experiences, digital ads, and marketing campaigns.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing tools, user behavior tools, and funnel analytics.
  • Experience in direct-response design or healthcare/e-commerce niches.
  • Strong understanding of UX heuristics and behavioral psychology.


Data Analysis is a plus


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: $2,500 – $3,500 USD
  • Work in a highly data-driven environment with fast testing cycles
  • Opportunity to directly influence revenue and performance
  • 100% remote and flexible work environment
  • Growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding global DTC brand

  • Scale a solution already validated by the largest AI data center deployment globally.

  • Shape the country playbook and help define how Latin America builds AI infrastructure.

title: PESSOA ENGENHEIRA DE DADOS SÊNIOR
description:
A epharma é uma das principais plataformas de gestão de benefícios de medicamentos no Brasil, conectando tecnologia e saúde de forma inovadora desde 1999. Como pioneira na criação do PBM – Plano de Benefícios de Medicamentos no país, a epharma atua como um elo estratégico entre indústrias farmacêuticas, farmácias, startups, setor público e empresas privadas de diversos segmentos. Com uma rede de mais de 42 mil farmácias e 2 mil clínicas e laboratórios de diagnóstico credenciados, a epharma já beneficiou mais de 32.9 milhões de pessoas, gerando uma economia superior a R$ 2.5 bilhões em 2024.

  • Integrar novas tecnologias de gerenciamento de dados e ferramentas de engenharia de software nas estruturas existentes;
  • Liderar tecnicamente a análise de dados e criar visualizações e relatórios, de modo a auxiliar a empresa na tomada de decisões com base em dados;

  • Recomendar formas de melhorar a confiabilidade dos dados, eficiência e qualidade;

  • Elaborar documentação técnica e científica.


Requisitos :

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica ou atuação como Tech Lead, Data Engineering Lead, Machine Learning Lead ou função equivalente.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação aplicadas a dados e alta performance: Python, Scala e Pyspark .
  • Experiência em engenharia de dados , arquitetura de dados , ETL/ELT e construção de pipelines.
  • Vivência com tecnologias de Big Data (Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Hive).
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais .
  • Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento (Git) e práticas de CI/CD.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise e visualização (Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou equivalentes).
  • Conhecimento em segurança da informação , governança de dados e conformidade (incluindo LGPD).
  • Experiência com ambientes on-premise , cloud ou híbridos.


Formação acadêmica :

Formação em Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.

Benefícios : Você decide o que é benefício para você! Oferecemos mais de 40 opções para você escolher e usar como quiser em nosso marketplace de benefícios.

Conheça todos os nosso benefícios incríveis:

Nossa cultura é movida por ownership, resultado e inovação. Acreditamos que cada epharmer é protagonista de sua jornada e peça fundamental no alcance de nossos objetivos estratégicos. Por isso, promovemos um ambiente onde o empoderamento, a colaboração e a busca constante por soluções inovadoras são os pilares do nosso crescimento. Somos uma organização dinâmica, que valoriza as conexões inteligentes e o impacto real que criamos na vida das pessoas.

Aqui, cada resultado é compartilhado e cada avanço é celebrado. Nossa missão é desafiar o status quo, oxigenar conexões e impulsionar a saúde em todas as dimensões. Com transparência e confiança, incentivamos cada colaborador a ir além, assumindo a responsabilidade por suas entregas e construindo, juntos, um legado de transformação.

POR QUE FAZER PARTE DA EPHARMA?

Fazemos mais do que conectar pessoas à saúde. Construímos experiências que inspiram. Somos uma empresa certificada como GPTW e nosso compromisso vai além dos números: queremos ser referência em pessoas e resultados, inovando continuamente. Se você é movido(a) por desafios, acredita no poder da inovação e busca resultados com propósito, aqui é o seu lugar.

Junte-se ao propósito de transformar a saúde com inovação e protagonismo. Vem ser um epharmer!

description:

  • Testes automatizados (unitários, integração, end-to-end).

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Business Development Associate
description:
As a Business Development Associate , you will play a key role in driving the company’s growth by building strategic partnerships and acquiring new merchants. You’ll be responsible for identifying high-potential markets, executing outbound sales strategies, and managing the full sales cycle—from prospecting and pitching to onboarding and integration support. This role also involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams to align on go-to-market initiatives and ensure merchant success. Your insights will help shape product enhancements and commercial strategies through valuable market feedback.


What You Will Need To Do

  • Build and manage business partnerships, implement new sources of merchant acquisition and growth.
  • Identify high-potential businesses, verticals, and markets to develop and execute outbound sales strategies to onboard new clients.
  • Reach out to potential merchants and partners, understand their business needs, and present payment solutions in a consultative sales style.
  • Manage your sales pipeline from prospecting, qualifying, researching, pitching, and providing necessary support to ensure the timely integration of merchants.
  • Work closely with marketing, product, and other teams to develop and execute sales and marketing activities;
  • Provide market feedback to the company’s leadership and product development team regarding competitive offerings and prospects’ needs, generate product development ideas, and help develop cross-sell and upsell strategies.


What You Will Need To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, sales, partnerships, or client acquisition (preferably in fintech, e-commerce, or SaaS).
  • Familiarity with digital payments, merchant onboarding processes, or online platforms is a plus.
  • Strong command of English; additional languages are an advantage in regional sales.
  • Experience with CRM tools and outbound sales platforms is beneficial.
  • Proficiency in English, and other foreign languages is preferred.


Why Join Us?

If you are eager to take your career to the next level in the payment industry, this is the opportunity for you. We offer:

  • Competitive compensation depending on experience and skills.
  • Career advancement opportunities across a global network.
  • A dynamic, international team environment.
  • Exposure to the fintech and gaming industries.
  • Office-based role in Curitiba.


This role is the ideal opportunity for someone looking for new challenges that would allow them to make a noticeable, positive impact in the company while learning and adapting to our fast-paced scale-up environment.

As part of our growing team in Curitiba, you will have a lot of opportunities to develop your career further with us. With future expansion plans, now is a great time to join us on our journey to change the way we pay.


Notes: Kindly submit the English Version of your CV and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role -LLM - Full Stack Python + JS

Project duration: 3 Months

Exp - 3+ Years

Skill - Python, JavaScript / Node.js, TypeScript

Availability - 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.


Role Overview :

We’re a coding-focused team at Turing that serves as a research partner for a Frontier AI Lab. Our role is to build coding tasks, evaluations, datasets, and tooling that help train and improve large language models (LLMs).

You’ll write and debug production-quality code, design rigorous evaluations, and build reproducible workflows that generate clean, high-signal data for model training. Attention to detail matters deeply here—small mistakes can cascade into misleading results, so precision and thoroughness are essential. You’ll also collaborate closely with engineers, researchers, and quality owners to align on standards, review work, and continuously raise the quality bar.

If you enjoy solving unusual technical problems, investigating subtle model failures, and working in developer-like environments where correctness, reproducibility, and collaboration matter, this role will keep you very entertained.


What does your day-to-day look like :

  • Write, review, and debug code across multiple languages
  • Design tasks and evaluation scenarios for coding, reasoning, and debugging
  • Investigate LLM outputs and identify hallucinations, regressions, and failure modes
  • Build reproducible dev environments using Docker + automation tools
  • Develop scripts, pipelines, and tools for data generation, scoring, and validation
  • Produce structured annotations, judgments, and high-quality datasets
  • Run systematic evaluations that help improve model reliability and reasoning

Required Skills :

  • Experience using LLM coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, CodeWhisperer)Strong hands-on coding experience (professional or research-based) in one or more of:
  • Python, JavaScript / Node.js, TypeScript
  • (Additional languages like Go, Java, C++, C#, Rust, SQL, R, Dart, etc. are a plus)
  • Solid experience with Linux + Bash, scripting, and automation
  • Strong with Docker, reproducible environments, and dev containers
  • Advanced Git skills (branching, diffs, patches, conflict resolution)
  • Solid understanding of testing and QA (unit, integration, negative, edge-case focused)
  • Ability to reliably overlap with 8am–12pm PT

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:

Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:

1. Desenvolvimento e Entrega Técnica

  • Construção da API Core: Desenvolver e manter endpoints RESTful eficientes utilizando Ruby on Rails para suportar as aplicações Web e Mobile.
  • Escrita de Testes Automatizados: Garantir a estabilidade do sistema através de testes de integração e unitários (RSpec), utilizando VCR e WebMock para garantir que as dependências externas não atrasem o pipeline.
  • Otimização de Performance: Garantir que a API seja rápida e escalável, aplicando boas práticas de banco de dados (PostgreSQL) e evitando gargalos de processamento.


2. Integração e Homologação (Foco em Qualidade)

  • Validação de Integração: Testar e homologar ativamente as interações da API com o desenvolvimento Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os dados trafegados estejam corretos e performáticos.
  • Garantia de Eficiência: Assegurar a máxima qualidade no processo de integração, antecipando falhas de contrato de dados e garantindo que as funcionalidades atendam aos requisitos de UI/UX de ambos os clientes.
  • Definição de Contratos: Colaborar no desenho técnico prévio dos endpoints para garantir que o time de Front-end tenha mocks funcionais e especificações claras, minimizando o retrabalho.


3. Colaboração e Alinhamento

  • Gestão de Bloqueios: Atuar de forma proativa para identificar e comunicar impedimentos técnicos que possam impactar o cronograma de 3 meses.
  • Code Review: Participar de revisões de código focadas em manter o padrão de qualidade da equipe e a consistência do \"Rails Way\".


4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Profissional: Manter-se atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, trazendo as melhores práticas de segurança e arquitetura para o projeto a longo prazo.
  • Aprimoramento de Processos: Analisar constantemente o ciclo de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias que tornem o fluxo de deploy e a integração com o front-end mais ágeis.


5. Documentação e Sustentabilidade

  • Documentação Técnica: Manter uma documentação clara e atualizada da API (ex: Swagger/OpenAPI) para servir como fonte única de verdade para os times de consumo.
  • Manutenibilidade: Equilibrar o pragmatismo da entrega rápida com a saúde do código, garantindo uma base sólida para a evolução permanente do produto.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Ruby on Rails (Modo API): Domínio profundo do framework, priorizando o \"Rails Way\" e o uso de scaffolding eficiente para velocidade de entrega.
  • Design de API RESTful: Experiência em estruturar endpoints que atendam simultaneamente Web e Mobile (JSON, paginação, versionamento).
  • Testes e Mocking (RSpec): Domínio de VCR e WebMock para simular interações externas de forma determinística, garantindo uma suíte de testes rápida e confiável.
  • Modelagem de Dados: Experiência com PostgreSQL e uso eficiente de Active Record (evitando o problema de N+1).
  • Autenticação e Segurança: Implementação prática de JWT ou Devise Token Auth.
  • Pragmatismo e Foco: Foco em resolver o problema de negócio com a solução mais simples e direta, evitando \"overengineering\".
  • Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Habilidade de alinhar contratos de API antecipadamente com os times de Front-end e Mobile para evitar bloqueios e garantir que a integração seja fluida.
  • Antecipação de Riscos (Atitude Dono): Capacidade de identificar gargalos ou requisitos ambíguos precocemente, levantando a mão e propondo soluções para evitar retrabalhos.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Mentalidade colaborativa, compartilhando conhecimento e garantindo que o código seja legível e mantível para o restante do time.
  • Autonomia: Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas alinhadas às convenções do Rails sem necessidade de microgerenciamento.


Diferencial (IA): Uso de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a escrita de código e geração de mocks de dados.

title: Integration Engineer - Developer n8n Specialist
description:
Location: Remote | Industry: Retail / E-commerce Technology


About the Mission

We are leading a strategic technological transformation at the heart of our retail operations. We are migrating our core automation and integration layer from Workato to a self-hosted n8n platform. This isn't just an update; it's a complete rebuild for scale, control, and performance.

We are looking for the lead engineer to own this critical migration and shape the future of how our enterprise systems—like RetailPro, SAP, Oracle, and Amazon S3—communicate and automate.

If you are a developer who thrives on complex integrations, enjoys the challenge of platform migration, and wants to see your architecture decisions power a high-volume business, this is your role.


Your Core Challenge

You will be the technical owner of the \"Workato to n8n\" migration project. Your primary mission is to design, execute, and optimize the new automation ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Migration: Architect and execute the full migration of complex automation workflows from Workato to a self-hosted n8n environment.
  • Build Enterprise Integrations: Develop, maintain, and optimize high-volume, reliable workflows connecting critical systems: RetailPro, SAP (ECC/S4HANA), Amazon S3, Oracle DB, Snowflake, and various APIs.
  • Ensure Robust Connectivity: Design and implement secure, reliable connectivity solutions between our n8n platform and on-premise systems.
  • Champion Reliability: Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve the performance and uptime of all automated processes.
  • Own the Platform: Make key decisions on the n8n deployment, scaling, and best practices, acting as the subject-matter expert.


Who We Are Looking For

Must-Have Skills (Non-negotiable):

  • 3+ years of hands-on, production experience with n8n. You have built, deployed, and maintained complex workflows.
  • Proven experience with self-hosted n8n deployments. You understand the infrastructure, scaling, and security aspects.
  • Direct experience migrating from one iPaaS platform to another, preferably from Workato, Zapier, or Make. You know the pitfalls and patterns of platform migration.
  • Strong understanding of secure integration patterns for on-premise systems (e.g., via SSH tunnels, VPN, agents).
  • Experience with event-driven and file-based automation architectures.

Highly Valued Skills (Nice-to-Have):

  • Development experience with JavaScript/TypeScript for writing custom n8n nodes or logic.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (EC2, S3, IAM).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code for n8n deployments.
  • Familiarity with RetailPro, SAP B1/ECC, or Oracle E-Business Suite from an integration perspective.


  • Why You Should ApplyOwn a Strategic Project: This is not a maintenance role. You will own and define a migration that is critical to business operations.
  • Solve Complex Problems: Work on challenging integrations that move data between the core systems of a major retailer.
  • Technical Autonomy: You will be the expert. We trust you to make the right technical decisions and shape the platform's future.
  • Growth & Impact: Your work will directly influence operational efficiency and provide visible value across the company.
  • Modern Stack: Work with a leading, developer-friendly automation tool (n8n) in a modern, cloud-aware context.


Salary: 5000USD

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

title: Senior Back-End Engineer (PHP, Node.js, OR Python)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Back-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience. The role focuses on designing and building the secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouse, and embedded analytics ecosystem.

This role acts as the bridge between the application stack and the data platform, ensuring that analytics, reporting, and automation capabilities are seamlessly exposed to both internal systems and customer-facing applications.

The ideal candidate is a backend engineer experienced with modern frameworks (PHP, Node.js, or Python), API design, multi-tenant authentication (Auth0/SSO), and data service abstractions. They combine strong engineering fundamentals with a deep appreciation for performance, security, and maintainability.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement RESTful and GraphQL APIs that expose warehouse and reporting data to SaaS applications and third-party systems
  • Develop scalable, tenant-aware service layers that abstract complex Redshift or Snowflake queries behind stable, versioned interfaces
  • Build secure integrations between the SaaS application and analytics systems (QuickSight embedding, SSO/role propagation, etc.)
  • Ensure multi-tenant context propagation and data isolation across all API endpoints
  • Work with the Data Platform and Analytics teams to define reusable data-access abstractions
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform Architect to design backend patterns supporting large-scale, automated reporting workloads
  • Implement caching, pagination, and batching strategies for high-volume, concurrent
  • analytics requests
  • Monitor API latency and database query efficiency, applying indexing and optimization
  • where necessary
  • Contribute to system design documentation, endpoint versioning, and architecture diagrams
  • Integrate SSO and identity management (Auth0, Cognito, or OIDC) into all service endpoints
  • Enforce least-privilege data access and row-level security (RLS) through token or role propagation
  • Ensure compliance with PII and data governance policies, encryption standards, and audit logging
  • Collaborate with InfoSec and Compliance teams to perform code reviews and security assessments
  • Work with DevOps to deploy and scale backend services via Docker, ECS, or EKS pipelines
  • Implement CI/CD automation for service deployment, schema migrations, and integration tests
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code definitions (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Support observability and monitoring via CloudWatch, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers and Data Platform teams to ensure APIs align with data contracts and warehouse schemas
  • Collaborate with Product Managers to define API requirements and roadmap priorities
  • Participate in technical design reviews, security audits, and postmortems
  • Continuously improve service performance, reliability, and developer experience


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of backend or integration engineering experience in a modern web stack
  • Proficiency in PHP (Laminas, Symfony, Laravel), Node.js, or Python for backend service development
  • Experience designing and maintaining RESTful and GraphQL APIs at scale
  • Hands-on experience integrating data warehouse APIs (Redshift, Snowflake) or analytics services (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Solid understanding of multi-tenant authentication and authorization (SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect)
  • Familiarity with AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, and CloudFormation
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and data-access patterns, including query optimization and caching
  • Proven experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and API observability


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some type of technical engineering
  • Experience with embedded analytics frameworks (AWS QuickSight Embedding SDK, Looker Embed, etc.)
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures (tenant isolation, provisioning, and lifecycle automation)
  • Knowledge of GraphQL federation, caching layers (Redis), and event-driven designs
  • Experience in data-driven SaaS products (hospitality, property management, or fintech a plus)
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, and API auditing practices


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays

Requirements:

  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Petroleum, or related) or Business Administration. MBA or postgraduate studies are a plus.

O Engenheiro de Software Pleno Mobile Flutter (PJ) será responsável por:

1. Desenvolvimento e Entrega Contínua

  • Evolução do App: Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e componentes com foco em código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção.
  • Ciclo de Releases Semanais: Garantir a entrega de incrementos de software funcionais e testados ao final de cada ciclo, respeitando os prazos das sprints.


2. Colaboração e Qualidade Técnica

  • Review de Código: Realizar revisões de código (Code Reviews) dos parceiros de equipe, garantindo a manutenção dos padrões técnicos, a disseminação de conhecimento e a qualidade da base de código.
  • Apoio à Liderança: Prestar suporte técnico ao Líder Técnico e ao Gerente de Produto na viabilidade de novas features, ajudando a quebrar requisitos complexos em tarefas técnicas menores e estimáveis.
  • Sintonia com Backend: Colaborar ativamente na definição e consumo dos endpoints, garantindo que a comunicação entre App e API seja performática e segura.


3. Sustentação e Suporte

  • Atendimento de Chamados: Atuar no suporte e resolução de chamados de nível técnico, identificando a causa raiz de bugs reportados e implementando correções definitivas.
  • Homologação e Testes: Testar e validar cada funcionalidade em múltiplos dispositivos, garantindo que a experiência do usuário seja consistente em Android e iOS.


4. Excelência em UI/UX e Performance

  • Garantia de Fidelidade Visual: Assegurar que o produto final seja uma cópia fiel do design proposto (Figma), mantendo a máxima qualidade estética e fluidez de navegação.
  • Otimização de Performance: Monitorar e melhorar constantemente a performance do aplicativo (tempo de resposta, consumo de bateria e memória).


5. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Técnica: Manter-se atualizado com as atualizações do ecossistema Flutter/Dart, aplicando melhorias que tornem o processo de desenvolvimento mais eficiente.
  • Mentalidade Proativa: Identificar antecipadamente riscos de integração ou atrasos, propondo soluções ao time para evitar retrabalhos ou bloqueios nas entregas semanais.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Domínio de Flutter & Dart: Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de aplicações robustas para Android e iOS a partir de uma base de código única.
  • Fidelidade ao Layout (Pixel Perfect): Capacidade de transformar designs complexos (Figma) em interfaces funcionais com alta precisão, respeitando rigorosamente guias de estilo e componentes.
  • Consumo de APIs REST & Resiliência: Experiência avançada em integração com APIs, com tratamento de erros de rede, estados de loading/empty e estratégias de cache offline.
  • Gerenciamento de Estado Profissional: Domínio de soluções escaláveis como Bloc, Riverpod ou Provider, garantindo a separação clara entre lógica de negócio e UI.
  • Performance e Otimização: Habilidade em identificar e corrigir gargalos de performance (jank), otimização de imagens e gerenciamento eficiente de memória.
  • Testes e Qualidade: Experiência na escrita de testes unitários e de widgets para garantir a estabilidade das funcionalidades core durante as evoluções do app.
  • Pragmatismo e Foco em Valor: Mentalidade voltada para soluções que equilibram rapidez de entrega com robustez técnica, evitando complexidade desnecessária.
  • Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Trabalho em sintonia fina com o desenvolvedor Backend para alinhar contratos de API e evitar retrabalhos nas integrações.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor visual e funcional; o aplicativo deve ser polido e fiel à identidade visual em diferentes tamanhos de tela.
  • Agilidade e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de trabalhar com releases semanais, mantendo a cadência de entrega e a qualidade sem comprometer a estabilidade das versões anteriores.
  • Atitude de Dono (Proatividade): Identificar precocemente riscos técnicos ou inconsistências no design e propor soluções antes que se tornem bloqueios para a release.


Cuidados com a nossa gente:

Mantemos um ambiente descontraído, onde cada ideia conta. Na base da colaboração e criatividade, a gente está sempre evoluindo e de olho nas tendências que movem o mundo fitness

title: Platform Engineer (AWS)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer , DevOps Engineer , or Infrastructure Engineer with focus on developer enablement .
  • Deep expertise in AWS , especially working with services like ECS , IAM , and supporting microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub , GitHub Actions , and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python , Bash , or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage .
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.
  • Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic , such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced) .


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform , enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions , ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS , based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows , including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: SASE Network Engineer
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


Job Title: Senior SASE Network Engineer

Location: Latham

Duration: 1+ Year


Role Description:

The Senior Network Engineer, SASE will serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for all SASE-related technologies, driving the network and security transformation from traditional, perimeter-based models to a secure, cloud-centric architecture. This role involves integrating core SASE components—such as SD-WAN, Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), Secure Web Gateway (SWG), and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)—to deliver secure and high-performance access for all users, regardless of location. Join us to tackle challenging projects and make a direct impact on our core product while investing in your professional growth.


This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be located in Bengaluru, India. At Client, our vision is to be the leading provider of seamlessly connected diagnostic solutions.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Design and Architect highly available, scalable, and secure SASE solutions for complex, global, and hybrid-cloud network environments.
  • Lead the implementation and deployment of core SASE components, including SD-WAN, ZTNA, CASB, Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS), and DNS security solutions.
  • Develop, implement, and optimize security policies, routing, and traffic steering logic across the SASE platform to enforce a consistent security posture.
  • Evaluate and integrate new SASE-related technologies and features to maintain a state-of-the-art security and networking stack.
  • Drive Zero Trust principles by designing and implementing fine-grained, identity-centric access control policies (ZTNA).
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities using scripting and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools to increase deployment speed and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with Cyber Security teams to ensure SASE policies and configurations align with organizational security standards and compliance requirements (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, ISO).


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in network and/or security engineering, with at least 2 years focused on SASE or similar cloud security architectures.
  • Expert knowledge of SASE Framework and its core components (SD-WAN, ZTNA, CASB, SWG, FWaaS).
  • Extensive hands-on experience with major SASE vendor solutions (e.g., Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks Prisma Access, Fortinet, Cisco/Meraki).
  • Deep understanding of Network Protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and IPsec VPNs.
  • Proficiency in Cloud Networking and security principles in one or more major public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong Scripting and Automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Terraform, Ansible) for infrastructure provisioning and management.
  • Familiarity with Network Security concepts such as Next-Generation Firewalls, IDS/IPS, TLS inspection, and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)



Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-15% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Python, YAML
  • Jira, Confluence
  • Ansible automation

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Us


Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


We’re building the infrastructure that powers smarter agency discovery, matchmaking, and evaluation—and we’re looking for a developer who wants real ownership over how that system is built and evolves.


⸻


The Role


As Vendry’s Developer, you’ll be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the core technical infrastructure that powers the Vendry platform. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership across frontend, backend, and internal tooling.


You’ll manage everything from our public-facing website and landing pages to our agency portal and proprietary agency search engine. You’ll work closely with the founding team to ship features quickly, improve performance and reliability, and help shape the technical direction of the product.


This is an ideal role for a developer who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys autonomy, and is excited to build and iterate fast.


⸻


Responsibilities

• Own and manage Vendry’s full technical stack, including:

• Frontend website and marketing landing pages

• Agency portal and internal tools

• Proprietary agency search and matchmaking engine

• Build, ship, and maintain new features across the product with a focus on speed, quality, and scalability.

• Ensure the platform is reliable, performant, and secure as usage grows.

• Collaborate closely with product, operations, and leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Stay up to date on modern development trends, tools, and best practices.

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve velocity and code quality.

• Troubleshoot issues across the stack and proactively improve system architecture.

• Document technical decisions and maintain clean, readable codebases.


⸻


Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience as a software developer or engineer.

• Experience working in a startup environment is a must.

• Strong experience with modern frontend and backend development.

• Comfortable owning projects end-to-end, from idea to production.

• Familiarity with databases, APIs, and search or filtering systems is a plus.

• Experience building or maintaining SaaS products or internal platforms is strongly preferred.

• Curious, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and clear written communication.


⸻


Compensation

• Salary: $2,000–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and scope.

• Full-time, remote role.


⸻


Why Join Vendry


Joining Vendry means having real ownership over a product that’s redefining how brands find agency partners. You won’t be maintaining a tiny slice of a massive codebase—you’ll be shaping the foundation of a growing platform.


  • We’re a small, fast-moving team that values initiative, clarity of thinking, and building practical solutions that actually get used. If you enjoy shipping, iterating, and seeing your work directly impact the business, you’ll feel right at home.
